statement: (∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1/2) → let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (X d : ℕ), 2 ≤ X → d ≤ X → Odd d → |((w X).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ d ∣ p+2)).sum (fun p => Real.log p) - (X:ℝ)/(50*Nat.totient d)| ≤ C*Real.sqrt X*(Real.log (2*(d:ℝ)*X))^2
